title: Wizard Layout
content: Create multi-step wizard/form layout. Structure: progress indicator top, step content center, navigation bottom. Progress: horizontal steps showing completed (check), current (highlighted), upcoming (gray). Step indicator: numbered circles connected by lines. Content area: centered, max-w-2xl. Form validation: validate current step before proceeding. Navigation: "Back" and "Continue" buttons. Save progress: persist to localStorage. Review step: final step showing all entered data.

variants.simple: Create multi-step wizard with progress indicator and form navigation.
variants.detailed: Create multi-step wizard/form layout. Structure: progress indicator top, step content center, navigation bottom. Progress: horizontal steps showing completed (check), current (highlighted), upcoming (gray). Step indicator: numbered circles connected by lines. Content area: centered, max-w-2xl. Form validation: validate current step before proceeding. Navigation: "Back" and "Continue" buttons. Save progress: persist to localStorage. Review step: final step showing all entered data.
variants.advanced: Create multi-step wizard/form layout with validation and persistence. Structure: flex flex-col min-h-screen. Progress indicator: sticky top-0 bg-white border-b py-4 px-6 z-10. Horizontal stepper: flex justify-between items-center max-w-3xl mx-auto. Each step: flex flex-col items-center. Step circle: w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-medium. States: completed (bg-green-500 text-white with Check icon), current (bg-blue-600 text-white ring-4 ring-blue-100), upcoming (bg-gray-200 text-gray-500). Connecting lines: flex-1 h-0.5 mx-2, bg-green-500 if previous completed, bg-gray-200 otherwise. Step labels below: text-xs, font-medium for current, text-gray-500 for others. Responsive: on mobile (sm:hidden), show simplified "Step 2 of 4" text or vertical layout. Content area: flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 py-8. Inner container: max-w-2xl w-full. Step content: rendered based on currentStep state, each step is a form section. Step transitions: fade or slide animation between steps using AnimatePresence (Framer Motion) or CSS transitions. Form validation: validate current step fields before allowing next. Use react-hook-form or Formik for form state. Show inline errors, prevent advancement if invalid. Navigation: fixed bottom-0 or sticky, bg-white border-t p-4. Buttons: "Back" secondary button (left, hidden on first step), "Continue" primary button (right, shows "Submit" or "Complete" on final step). Button states: disabled during validation, loading during save. Step summary: optionally show completed step summaries above current step (collapsible accordions with "Edit" links). Save progress: persist form state to localStorage on each step change and on input change (debounced). On return, offer to resume from saved progress. Skip steps: optionally allow skipping non-required steps (shown as "Skip" text button), track skipped state. Review step: final step showing all entered data in read-only format, organized by section, "Edit" link per section to jump back. Loading: spinner overlay during save/submit operations. Success screen: completion screen with success icon, summary, next action buttons ("Go to Dashboard", "Add Another"). Error recovery: if submission fails, show error, allow retrying or going back to fix issues. Accessibility: announce step changes, form labels, error messages.
